user.title: Connect UniFi Protect Zone Tracking
user.description: A second, independent connection to the same Protect NVR as the official UniFi Protect integration - used only to derive the zone order of each smart-detect event.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Protect NVR.

init.title: UniFi Protect Zone Tracking options
init.description: Protect only publishes a detection track once the event has ended, so the per-zone sensors report as a pulse: they turn on when the event is processed and off again after this delay.
